key_highlights: ASX 200 set to retreat following an overnight Wall Street tech sell-off and domestic growth shock signals.
RBA Deputy Governor warns of worsening inflation, driving market expectations higher for a fifth rate hike this year.
Australian flash PMI plunges into contraction, signaling worsening stagflationary pressures as energy prices remain sticky.
China-Australia iron ore dispute resurfaces, placing major miners (BHP, RIO, FMG) at risk amid broader market volatility.
NextDC shares tumble on Melbourne data centre expansion delays, amplifying the domestic AI/tech sell-off.

sectors.trend: Sharp valuation de-rating and project execution setbacks.
sectors.implications: US tech rout and NextDC's Melbourne delay pressure ASX tech multiples and test AI infrastructure appetite.

sectors.trend: Geopolitical trade friction in iron ore offset by gold M&A and critical minerals exploration.
sectors.implications: China tensions threaten bulk export volumes and margins for majors, while WA gold consolidation offers safe-haven support.

sectors.trend: Crude oil surges to multi-month highs amidst domestic capex blowouts and ESG emissions scrutiny.
sectors.implications: Upstream oil benefits from price spikes, but Gorgon satellite emissions warnings and Snowy 2.0 cost blowout to $25b escalate capital and regulatory risks.

sectors.trend: Margin pressure, aggressive cost management, and mounting asset quality concerns.
sectors.implications: Westpac job cuts highlight efficiency drives, while hawkish RBA rate hike risks accelerate mortgage stress and property price falls.

sectors.trend: Severe margin compression and weakening household demand.
sectors.implications: Nick Scali sell-off underlines consumer belt-tightening as higher-for-longer mortgage rates suppress discretionary spending.

sectors.trend: Defensive resilience with idiosyncratic pipeline developments.
sectors.implications: Biotech clinical trial progress in oncology provides non-correlated upside while large-cap healthcare acts as a defensive buffer.

key_themes: Stagflationary headwind: Contracting flash PMI alongside sticky energy costs and hawkish RBA rate hike prospects.
Housing market correction: Surging property listings and tighter monetary policy driving widespread dwelling price declines.
Resources geopolitical exposure: Renewed China-Australia trade friction over iron ore supply chains.
Infrastructure & energy transition capex inflation: Major public and corporate project delays and cost blowouts.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight defensive, cash-generative sectors; reduce exposure to highly leveraged borrowers and rate-sensitive REITs.
Hedge bulk commodity exposure; diversify mining holdings into gold and base metals.
Trim high PE technology growth names with delayed project execution timelines.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Domestic Economic Contraction & Flash PMI Slump
risk_assessment.mitigation: Rotate out of cyclical retail and industrial equities into non-cyclical healthcare and essential infrastructure.

opportunities.rationale: Gold provides an essential hedge against stagflation, geopolitical uncertainty, and AUD weakness amidst active domestic M&A.

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical Exposure to Upstream Oil & Gas
opportunities.rationale: Crude oil hitting five-month highs delivers strong free cash flow and near-term earnings upgrades for major producers.

defensive_moves.rationale: Rising rate expectations and project delays in data centres expose high-multiple tech and discretionary retail to sharp earnings downgrades.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge Core Equity Portfolio against Macro Contraction
defensive_moves.rationale: Plunging flash PMI and hawkish RBA guidance raise near-term ASX 200 downside risks.

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish bias over 1–3 months as the ASX 200 absorbs higher domestic rate hike probabilities, flash PMI contraction, and tech multiple deflation.
market_outlook.long_term: Neutral over 6–12 months; balance sheet strength in large-cap resources and defensive healthcare provides support once monetary policy reaches terminal level.
key_catalysts: Upcoming RBA Board meeting rate decision and updated inflation forecasts
Australian quarterly CPI and labour market prints
Developments in China-Australia bilateral iron ore trade talks
